values.note: Forest Service developed-dispersed camping: no reservations or fee. Monongahela rules: no more than 14 cumulative days at one site within a 28-day period, then move more than 5 road miles or wait 21 days; vehicles must stay on or adjacent to roads open to public travel.

booking.source: Monongahela NF release reprinted by Parsons Advocate 2023-04-24 (https://parsonsadvocate.com/news/pa-top-stories/headlines/monongahela-national-forest-issues-reminder-about-camping-and-food-storage-regulations/: 'developed-dispersed campsites available free of charge'; 'Dispersed camping areas on the Marlinton-White Sulphur Ranger District (304-536-2144 or 304-799-4334) in the White Sulphur Springs area: ... Lake Sherwood Recreation Area entrance road dispersed camping (State Route 14)'; 'Exceeding the 14-day maximum length of stay within a 28-day period') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions (Forest Order: 14 cumulative days within a 28-day period outside developed campgrounds), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Opens 'When snow free' (Forest Service 2026 opening list); no closing date published.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation ('2026 Recreation Opening Dates ... Marlinton-White Sulphur Ranger District in the White Sulphur Springs area: ... Lake Sherwood Entrance Road Dispersed Camping (State Route 14)— When snow free'), read 2026-10-22

summary: These are the Forest Service's 'Lake Sherwood Recreation Area entrance road dispersed camping (State Route 14)' sites along Meadow Creek below Lake Sherwood (the pin is on Lake Sherwood Road, ~7 km SW of the lake): booking confirmed from the FS release and forest order (first-come, no reservations, 14 days in 28; platform none added); season recorded as opening when snow-free. Fees ($0) left. Note (AWH) unchanged.
flags: Name: the Forest Service calls this area 'Lake Sherwood Recreation Area entrance road dispersed camping (State Route 14)' (2026 list: 'Lake Sherwood Entrance Road Dispersed Camping (State Route 14)'). Not to be confused with Lake Sherwood campground's reservable 'Meadow Creek Loop' ($20 single sites, opens 5/18), which is a different, developed loop.

Missing website: no Forest Service page for the area itself; official mentions are the 2026 opening-dates list on https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/recreation and the Forest's 2023 developed-dispersed release. Missing phone: Marlinton-White Sulphur Ranger District, White Sulphur Springs office, (304) 536-2144.

For information: Forest Order item 19 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r09/monongahela/alerts/general-use-restrictions) bans camping within 300 ft of the Lake Sherwood shore outside developed campsites; the pin is ~7 km down Meadow Creek, so it does not apply here. The access is a state/county route (State Route 14), not a Forest road; no agency vehicle-length, high-clearance or 4WD statement.
